client/src/lib/app-sdk/bifrost-header.ts.name: App header bar
client/src/lib/app-sdk/bifrost-header.ts.description: Draws the Bifrost bar across the top of an app, with section links and the signed-in person's menu.

client/src/lib/app-sdk/brand-palette.ts.name: Brand colours
client/src/lib/app-sdk/brand-palette.ts.description: Builds a matching set of colours from one brand colour and checks that text stays readable on them.

client/src/lib/app-sdk/branding-theme.ts.name: Brand styling
client/src/lib/app-sdk/branding-theme.ts.description: Applies the organization's colours and logo settings across an app's screens.

client/src/lib/app-sdk/errors.ts.name: Access error types
client/src/lib/app-sdk/errors.ts.description: Provides the standard errors an app shows when a table or file is missing or off limits.

client/src/lib/app-sdk/execution-stream..name: Live run updates
client/src/lib/app-sdk/execution-stream..description: Lets an app watch a workflow run and update as new log lines and status changes arrive.

client/src/lib/app-sdk/files.ts.name: File access for apps
client/src/lib/app-sdk/files.ts.description: Lets an app list, read, write, move and share files, and hand out temporary download links.

client/src/lib/app-sdk/hosted-binding.ts.name: App toolkit entry
client/src/lib/app-sdk/hosted-binding.ts.description: Provides the ready-made pieces an app imports: sign-in details, tables, files, workflows and access checks.

client/src/lib/app-sdk/hosted-contract.t.name: Toolkit version contract
client/src/lib/app-sdk/hosted-contract.t.description: Records which version of the app toolkit an app was built against, so it can be loaded safely.

client/src/lib/app-sdk/hosted-loader.ts.name: Toolkit loader
client/src/lib/app-sdk/hosted-loader.ts.description: Loads the matching app toolkit once per page and reuses it, so every app on the page shares one copy.

client/src/lib/app-sdk/index.v2.ts.name: App toolkit exports
client/src/lib/app-sdk/index.v2.ts.description: Lists everything an app can import from the Bifrost toolkit in one place.

client/src/lib/app-sdk/provider.tsx.name: App setup wrapper
client/src/lib/app-sdk/provider.tsx.description: Wraps an app in the shared settings it needs, such as which organization and person it is acting for.

client/src/lib/app-sdk/tables.ts.name: Table access for apps
client/src/lib/app-sdk/tables.ts.description: Lets an app read, add, change and watch records in a data table.

client/src/lib/app-sdk/transport.ts.name: Connection handling
client/src/lib/app-sdk/transport.ts.description: Holds the app's connection details and quietly renews a stale sign-in before retrying.

client/src/lib/app-sdk/use-api-query.ts.name: Data loading helper
client/src/lib/app-sdk/use-api-query.ts.description: Gives a screen a simple way to load data once and refresh it on demand.

client/src/lib/app-sdk/use-branding.ts.name: Brand settings hook
client/src/lib/app-sdk/use-branding.ts.description: Loads the organization's logo and colours for an app to use.

client/src/lib/app-sdk/use-files.ts.name: File list hook
client/src/lib/app-sdk/use-files.ts.description: Gives a screen a live list of files in a folder, with upload and delete helpers.

client/src/lib/app-sdk/use-infinite-tabl.name: Endless table hook
client/src/lib/app-sdk/use-infinite-tabl.description: Loads table records a page at a time as someone scrolls, and keeps them updating live.

client/src/lib/app-sdk/use-organizations.name: Organization list hook
client/src/lib/app-sdk/use-organizations.description: Lists the organizations the signed-in person is allowed to see.

client/src/lib/app-sdk/use-table.ts.name: Live table hook
client/src/lib/app-sdk/use-table.ts.description: Shows table records with paging and filters, and keeps the list current as records change.

client/src/lib/app-sdk/use-user.tsx.name: Signed-in person hook
client/src/lib/app-sdk/use-user.tsx.description: Tells a screen who is signed in and hides parts of it from people without the right role.

client/src/lib/app-sdk/use-workflow-hook.name: Workflow data and action hooks
client/src/lib/app-sdk/use-workflow-hook.description: Gives screens a familiar way to load a workflow's result and to trigger a workflow as an action.

client/src/lib/app-sdk/use-workflow.ts.name: Workflow run hook
client/src/lib/app-sdk/use-workflow.ts.description: Starts a workflow from an app and reports its status, result and log lines.

client/src/lib/app-sdk/wire-surface.ts.name: Connection surface record
client/src/lib/app-sdk/wire-surface.ts.description: Lists every server call the app toolkit makes, so changes to that surface are caught before release.

client/src/lib/app-sdk/ws-client.ts.name: Live update connection
client/src/lib/app-sdk/ws-client.ts.description: Keeps a live connection open so table and file changes reach the app without a refresh.
